### Day 1

## Content Update Essentials: Proven Methods to Identify & Prioritize

**Tuesday, September 24th, 2024** (10am – 11am EDT)

Step into the world of strategic content maintenance. This session is all about recognizing the signs that your content needs an update and understanding the pitfalls to avoid. You’ll discover:

- **Techniques to pinpoint pages in need of updates** using analytics and performance metrics.
- **Common mistakes** to avoid when planning content updates.
- **Effective approaches** to prioritize updates based on impact potential.

**The goal?**

To equip you with a clear process for identifying which pages will benefit most from a content update, ensuring your time and effort brings the best outcomes.

**\[Bonus\]**

Content Update Checklist – a custom guide to help you decide which content updates to tackle first.

### Day 2

## Refresh and Dominate: Content Update in Practice

**Wednesday, September 25th, 2024** (10am – 11am EDT)
